extracted.intended_audience: GAP users and developers working with partial permutations (mathematicians and programmers)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference documentation for creating, inspecting, converting, operating on, and displaying partial permutations in GAP, including representation, attribute definitions, and required preconditions for operations. Covers functions, their return values, edge cases, and display preferences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural partial order (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: For an inverse semigroup S, define x ≤ y if there exists an idempotent e in S such that x = e y. For partial permutations, f ≤ g iff f is a restriction of g.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the natural partial order on partial permutations; it is only a partial order (elements may be incomparable). See NaturalLeqPartialPerm (54.5.13).

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural partial order is a meet semilattice
rubrics_metrics.description: The natural partial order on partial permutations is a meet semilattice: every pair of elements has a greatest lower bound (meet).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Meet always exists (MeetOfPartialPerms). The join (supremum) does not always exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal storage representation
rubrics_metrics.description: A partial permutation f is stored as a list consisting of the codegree and the images i^f for i up to the codegree; 0 stored where i^f is undefined. Domain and image sets are stored after they are computed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If codegree < 65536 then values stored as 16-bit integers and domain/image as immutable plain lists (IsPPerm2Rep). If codegree ≥ 65536, stored as 32-bit integers (IsPPerm4Rep). TrimPartialPerm can change representation in-place to use less memory when possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: PartialPerm creation: domain and image form
rubrics_metrics.description: PartialPerm(dom, img) creates a partial permutation mapping dom[i] to img[i], where dom is a set of positive integers and img is a duplicate-free list of positive integers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this when domain is sparse but small to type. Example: PartialPerm([1,5],[20,2]);

rubrics_metrics.name: PartialPerm creation: dense image list form
rubrics_metrics.description: PartialPerm(list) uses a dense image list: positive integer i maps to list[i] if list[i] != 0 and is undefined if list[i] = 0.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when codegree is small relative to largest domain point, e.g. PartialPerm([20,0,0,0,2]);

rubrics_metrics.name: Permutations vs partial permutations (distinct types)
rubrics_metrics.description: A partial permutation in GAP is never a permutation and a permutation is never a partial permutation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not assume permutations and partial permutations are interchangeable; use AsPartialPerm/AsPermutation conversions where appropriate. Example: a permutation fixing a point is not the same as a partial perm undefined at that point.

rubrics_metrics.name: PartialPermOp checks injectivity
rubrics_metrics.description: PartialPermOp(obj, list[, func]) returns the partial permutation corresponding to the action of obj on list via func; it returns fail if obj does not map elements of list injectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PartialPermOpNC does no injectivity checks and should be used only when it is guaranteed the arguments have the required properties.

rubrics_metrics.name: RestrictedPartialPerm behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: RestrictedPartialPerm(f, set) returns the partial permutation acting like f on points in set and undefined elsewhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to form restrictions; see examples where restricting to points outside domain yields a smaller partial perm.

rubrics_metrics.name: JoinOfPartialPerms: existence condition
rubrics_metrics.description: JoinOfPartialPerms(arg) returns the union (join/supremum) of partial permutations in arg if this union defines a partial permutation; otherwise it returns fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The union is a partial permutation iff f and g agree on dom(f) ∩ dom(g) and the images of dom(f)\dom(g) under f and dom(g)\dom(f) under g are disjoint. Use JoinOfIdempotentPartialPermsNC when arguments are known to be idempotents (no checks, better performance).

rubrics_metrics.name: MeetOfPartialPerms: always exists
rubrics_metrics.description: MeetOfPartialPerms(arg) returns the meet (greatest lower bound, infimum) of the partial permutations in arg; it is the greatest partial permutation which is a restriction of each argument.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unlike join, the meet always exists for partial permutations.

rubrics_metrics.name: EmptyPartialPerm
rubrics_metrics.description: EmptyPartialPerm() returns the empty partial permutation; shorthand for PartialPerm([]).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the multiplicative zero for partial permutations (see MultiplicativeZero).

rubrics_metrics.name: RandomPartialPerm forms and distribution note
rubrics_metrics.description: RandomPartialPerm(n) / RandomPartialPerm(set) / RandomPartialPerm(dom,img) produce random partial permutations with domain/image bounded by n or contained in set/dom,img respectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is not guaranteed that the chosen partial permutations follow a uniform distribution in any of these forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: DegreeOfPartialPerm (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: DegreeOfPartialPerm(f) returns the largest positive integer where f is defined (maximum element in domain).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For collections, degree is the largest degree of any element.

rubrics_metrics.name: CodegreeOfPartialPerm (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: CodegreeOfPartialPerm(f) returns the largest positive integer in the image of f.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For collections, codegree is the largest codegree among elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: RankOfPartialPerm (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: RankOfPartialPerm(f) returns the size of the domain (equivalently the size of the image list or image set) of f.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For a collection, rank is the size of the union of domains of its elements; may differ from size of union of images.

rubrics_metrics.name: DomainOfPartialPerm (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: DomainOfPartialPerm(f) returns the set of positive integers where f is defined. For a collection, returns the union of domains.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used by ImageListOfPartialPerm and for display options.

rubrics_metrics.name: ImageListOfPartialPerm (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: ImageListOfPartialPerm(f) returns the list of images corresponding to the domain list: ImageListOfPartialPerm(f)[i] = DomainOfPartialPerm(f)[i]^f for i from 1 to rank(f).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintains the order of DomainOfPartialPerm in its correspondence.

rubrics_metrics.name: ImageSetOfPartialPerm (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: ImageSetOfPartialPerm(f) returns the image set: the image list sorted into increasing order (set of points in image list).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for set-based comparisons and for display in 'domainimage' notation.

rubrics_metrics.name: FixedPointsOfPartialPerm
rubrics_metrics.description: FixedPointsOfPartialPerm(f) returns the set of points i in the domain such that i^f = i. For a collection, returns points fixed by every element of the collection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Related functions: NrFixedPoints returns the count.

rubrics_metrics.name: MovedPoints
rubrics_metrics.description: MovedPoints(f) returns the set of points in the domain i with i^f ≠ i. For a collection, returns points moved by some element of the collection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complementary to FixedPointsOfPartialPerm; NrMovedPoints returns the count.

rubrics_metrics.name: NrFixedPoints and NrMovedPoints (counts)
rubrics_metrics.description: NrFixedPoints(f) and NrMovedPoints(f) return the number of fixed and moved points respectively in the domain of f. For collections, counts reflect points fixed by every element or moved by some element.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Return non-negative integers; examples illustrate edge cases (identity returns full fixed point count, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: SmallestMovedPoint / LargestMovedPoint (definitions & edge cases)
rubrics_metrics.description: SmallestMovedPoint(f) returns the least positive integer i such that i^f ≠ i, or infinity if f is identity. LargestMovedPoint(f) returns the largest i^f ≠ i, or 0 if f is identity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For collections, returns smallest/largest point moved by at least one element; identity-only collection yields infinity/0 as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: SmallestImageOfMovedPoint / LargestImageOfMovedPoint
rubrics_metrics.description: SmallestImageOfMovedPoint(f) returns the smallest image i^f with i^f ≠ i (or infinity if identity). LargestImageOfMovedPoint returns the largest such image (or 0 if identity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For collections, considers images of points moved by at least one element; examples show behavior for semigroups containing only identities.

rubrics_metrics.name: IndexPeriodOfPartialPerm
rubrics_metrics.description: IndexPeriodOfPartialPerm(f) returns the least positive integers m, r such that f^(m+r) = f^m; these are the index and period of f.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to analyze eventual periodicity of powers; examples show f^6 = f^7 when [6,1] returned.

rubrics_metrics.name: SmallestIdempotentPower
rubrics_metrics.description: SmallestIdempotentPower(f) returns the least positive integer n such that f^n is idempotent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It equals the least multiple of the period of f that is greater than or equal to the index of f (see IndexPeriodOfPartialPerm).

rubrics_metrics.name: ComponentsOfPartialPerm
rubrics_metrics.description: ComponentsOfPartialPerm(f) returns a list of components of f: subsets of the domain whose union is the domain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each component corresponds to orbit-like structure under repeated application of f; use NrComponentsOfPartialPerm to get number of components.

rubrics_metrics.name: ComponentRepsOfPartialPerm (representatives)
rubrics_metrics.description: ComponentRepsOfPartialPerm(f) returns representatives of the components: for each component there is a unique element in domain but not image; returns the least-numbered such representatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unlike transformations, for partial permutations there is exactly one representative for every component. Representative i has the property that for every j ≠ i in the component there exists k with i^(f^k) = j.

rubrics_metrics.name: LeftOne and RightOne (local identities)
rubrics_metrics.description: LeftOne(f) returns the identity partial permutation whose domain and image equal the domain of f such that e * f = f. RightOne(f) returns the identity whose domain/image equal image(f) with f * e = f.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are local identity elements relative to f's domain or image; One(f) is the identity on union(domain,image).

rubrics_metrics.name: One (multiplicative neutral element)
rubrics_metrics.description: One(f) returns the multiplicative neutral element of f: the identity partial permutation on the union of domain and image of f (equivalently join of LeftOne and RightOne).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See OneImmutable reference; used when a neutral element for f is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: MultiplicativeZero
rubrics_metrics.description: MultiplicativeZero(f) returns the multiplicative zero element of f, which is the empty partial permutation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is consistent with EmptyPartialPerm().

rubrics_metrics.name: AsPartialPerm for permutations (variants)
rubrics_metrics.description: AsPartialPerm(f, set) returns the partial permutation that equals permutation f on set and is undefined elsewhere. AsPartialPerm(f) returns AsPartialPerm(f,[1..LargestMovedPoint(f)]). AsPartialPerm(f,n) returns restriction to [1..n].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remember that permutations are distinct objects from partial permutations in GAP; AsPartialPerm converts by restriction. Use PartialPermOp as alternate conversion.

rubrics_metrics.name: AsPartialPerm for transformations (injectivity & bounds)
rubrics_metrics.description: AsPartialPerm(f,set) (or AsPartialPerm(f,n)) returns the partial permutation obtained by restricting transformation f to set when set contains no elements exceeding degree(f) and f is injective on set; otherwise returns fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PartialPermOp can also convert transformations to partial permutations. Check injectivity and degree bounds before calling AsPartialPerm to avoid fail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inverse operator
rubrics_metrics.description: Inverse(f) returns the inverse of the partial permutation f.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inverse is the usual inverse in the symmetric inverse semigroup; use f^-1 notation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image access operator ^(i,f)
rubrics_metrics.description: ^(i,f) returns the image of positive integer i under f if defined, and 0 if not defined.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the direct access operator for image; use careful handling of 0 as 'undefined'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preimage access operator \/(i,f) for integers
rubrics_metrics.description: \/(i,f) returns the preimage of i under f if defined, and 0 if it is not. Note: this does not compute the inverse f^-1 to find the preimage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PreImagePartialPerm(f,i) to get preimage or fail when i not in image, or i / f notation as equivalent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conjugation and complexity note: f ^ g
rubrics_metrics.description: f ^ g returns g^-1 * f * g when f is a partial permutation and g is a permutation or partial permutation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This operation requires essentially the same number of steps as multiplying partial permutations (about one third as many as inverting and multiplying twice).

rubrics_metrics.name: Composition operator (*)
rubrics_metrics.description: f * g returns the composition of f and g when f and g are partial permutations or permutations. The product of a permutation and a partial permutation is returned as a partial permutation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard composition semantics; watch types of operands.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division operators: / and LeftQuotient
rubrics_metrics.description: f / g returns f * g^-1; LeftQuotient(g,f) returns g^-1 * f. Both accept permutations or partial permutations. These operations avoid explicit extra inversions and have complexity similar to half that required to invert then multiply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these for efficient quotient computations; implementations may be faster than naive invert-then-multiply sequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lexicographic compare operator \< (for partial perms)
rubrics_metrics.description: f < g returns true if the image of f on 1..degree(f) is lexicographically less than the corresponding image for g, false otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a total lexicographic compare on image lists up to f's degree; see ShortLexLeqPartialPerm and NaturalLeqPartialPerm for alternative orders.

rubrics_metrics.name: PermLeftQuoPartialPerm precondition & NC variant
rubrics_metrics.description: PermLeftQuoPartialPerm(f,g) returns the permutation on the image set of f induced by f^-1 * g when f and g have equal domain and image sets. The checked variant verifies equality of domain and image sets and errors otherwise; PermLeftQuoPartialPermNC does no checks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use NC variant only when arguments are guaranteed to satisfy equality conditions for better performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: PreImagePartialPerm behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: PreImagePartialPerm(f,i) returns the preimage of integer i under f if i belongs to image(f); otherwise returns fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equivalent to i / f (division notation). Use to detect membership in image set; examples show fail when not present.

rubrics_metrics.name: ComponentPartialPermInt (orbit by repeated application)
rubrics_metrics.description: ComponentPartialPermInt(f,i) returns the elements of the component of f containing i that can be obtained by repeatedly applying f to i.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns possibly empty list when i not in domain or orbit finite; examples illustrate various cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: NaturalLeqPartialPerm (restriction test)
rubrics_metrics.description: NaturalLeqPartialPerm(f,g) returns true iff f is a restriction of g (i.e., f ≤ g under the natural partial order), false otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because this is a partial order, f and g may be incomparable; NaturalLeqPartialPerm can return false both ways.

rubrics_metrics.name: ShortLexLeqPartialPerm (short-lex order)
rubrics_metrics.description: ShortLexLeqPartialPerm(f,g) returns true if the concatenation of domain and image list of f is short-lex less than the corresponding concatenation for g, false otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is NOT the natural partial order and differs from f < g (lexicographic image compare). Used for alternative total ordering heuristics.

rubrics_metrics.name: TrimPartialPerm (representation compaction)
rubrics_metrics.description: TrimPartialPerm(f) modifies f in-place to reduce memory use, e.g., changing internal representation from 32-bit to 16-bit integers when appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No value is returned; use when operations may have left f using larger-than-required storage (example shows IsPPerm4Rep true before, false after TrimPartialPerm).

rubrics_metrics.name: Display: PartialPermDisplayLimit behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: If rank r of partial permutation f exceeds user preference PartialPermDisplayLimit, f is displayed as <partial perm on r pts with degree m, codegree n> to abbreviate large outputs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Default PartialPermDisplayLimit is 100. When rank ≤ limit, display follows NotationForPartialPerms preference except for empty or identity partial permutations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Display notation option: component (default)
rubrics_metrics.description: NotationForPartialPerms = 'component' displays partial permutations as products of disjoint permutations and chains: permutations shown as usual (fixed points in round parentheses), chains in square brackets. This is the default and most compact format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Chains are sequences where c[1] in domain but not image, c[n] in image but not domain, and c[i]^f = c[i+1]. Example display provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Display notation option: domainimage
rubrics_metrics.description: NotationForPartialPerms = 'domainimage' displays partial permutation f as DomainOfPartialPerm(f) -> ImageListOfPartialPerm(f).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This format mirrors the mapping of domain list to image list directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Display notation option: permutation (input) form
rubrics_metrics.description: NotationForPartialPerms = 'permutation' displays f as PartialPerm(DomainOfPartialPerm(f), ImageListOfPartialPerm(f)), which corresponds to the input form for PartialPerm(dom,img).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This option shows the input representation explicitly; useful for copy-pasting input representation.
